name: @qu/relay
description: A Node.js Qu peer: persists to disk (FsAdapter, both /store and /blob), syncs with other peers over WebSocket (@qu/sync), and delivers Web Push notifications for thread messages. Built on @qu/foundation's RuntimeContainer from day one (docs/v3-technical-concept.md §2.1) instead of one growing composition-root class - PresenceTracker, RelaySettings, VapidKeyStore, PushDeliveryService, AdminHttp and HttpRouter are each independently testable modules. Deliberately does NOT yet serve apps or a shell (needs @qu/loader + apps/, neither built in V3 yet) - see http-router.js's own doc comment.
